heroTitle: A semantic layer for corporate real estate strategy.
heroSubtitle: We deploy a Common Data Model and CRE ontology that keeps your strategic data neutral, connects HR-Finance-CRE, and enables deterministic analytics and AI for portfolio decisions.

differentiators.title: Neutral by design
differentiators.desc: Agnostic to your service providers and software. We normalize data across HR, Finance, and CRE systems so strategy stays in your control.

differentiators.title: 10x faster data engineering
differentiators.desc: We automate the data engineering work so you get value in months, not multi-year internal data lake cycles.

differentiators.title: Deterministic AI foundation
differentiators.desc: We structure data for precision. AI that calculates with governance and repeatability, rather than guessing with probability.

problemBody: CRE decisions require dozens of stakeholders and confidential business context. But most tooling was built to capture reality, not forecast it, so strategy becomes manual, slow, and fragile.

problemCards.title: Systems of record cannot forecast
problemCards.desc: IWMS, ERPs, and workflow tools are great at tracking what happened. They struggle to connect decisions to future P&L, risk, ESG, and employee outcomes.

problemCards.title: The 80/20 data trap
problemCards.desc: Teams spend most of their time stitching data across disconnected systems, leaving too little time for portfolio strategy.

problemCards.title: Service-provider bias
problemCards.desc: Provider data models are optimized for provider delivery, not for the occupier's strategic decision making.

solutionBody: A proprietary Common Data Model built for the corporate occupier, paired with a CRE ontology that functions as a semantic layer for strategy and AI.

solutionCards.title: Common Data Model
solutionCards.body: Normalize data across CRE, Finance, HR, and providers while retaining decision-level grain.

solutionCards.title: CRE Ontology (Semantic Layer)
solutionCards.body: Add meaning and relationships so your data becomes an active strategic asset, not static records.

solutionCards.title: Invisible AI
solutionCards.body: The heavy lifting algorithms that drive performance predict utilization, find cost drivers, and model trade-offs with precision.

solutionCalloutTitle: We are not deploying another software.
solutionCalloutBody: We enhance your existing investments while building the AI-ready data foundation that powers operational and strategic capacity.
acceleratorBody: A 3-step methodology to build the foundational, AI-ready data asset that models the reality and possibilities of your portfolio.

acceleratorCta.label: Ask for a sample engagement plan

acceleratorSteps.title: Diagnose
acceleratorSteps.desc: Your IT team builds the house. We bring the meaning, acting as strategic translators so infrastructure supports operational reality, not just technical specs.

acceleratorSteps.title: Deploy
acceleratorSteps.desc: Implement a Common Data Model that enforces consistency and solves the grain problem so you do not lose decision-level fidelity (for example, GL transactional detail).

acceleratorSteps.title: Deliver
acceleratorSteps.desc: Stop the cycle of one-off reports. Architect an AI Factory, a reusable foundation where logic like Total Cost of Occupancy serves Finance, Operations, and Strategy at once.

outcomesBody: The result is not a new tool. It is a new way of working, faster decisions, stronger governance, and durable trust across stakeholders.

outcomesCards.title: Unlock strategic capacity (the 80/20 flip)
outcomesCards.desc: Automate data janitor work so the team spends less time prepping and more time managing the portfolio.

outcomesCards.title: Eradicate indecision
outcomesCards.desc: Replace manual reporting cycles with automated analytics to compress the time between a market signal and a strategic move.

outcomesCards.title: Executive narrative control
outcomesCards.desc: Reduce the recurring fire drill of meeting prep with auditable, executive-ready narratives on demand.

outcomesCards.title: Restore organizational trust
outcomesCards.desc: Replace best-guess estimates and Excel wars with governed logic and repeatable answers when Finance asks, Are you sure?

outcomesCards.title: Unified governance
outcomesCards.desc: Create a portfolio Rosetta Stone so HR, Finance, and CRE agree on one version of truth.

tracks.title: Track 1: Strategy architect
tracks.desc: When a major lease expires, generate scenarios that calculate true P&L impact, exit friction, capacity and constraints, and capital reality, without weeks of spreadsheet stitching.
bullets: True P&L impacts beyond cash flow

tracks.title: Track 2: Operational mechanic
tracks.desc: For monthly reviews, budgets, and accruals, solve data readiness upstream so BI teams stop cleaning data and start delivering insight.
bullets: Semantic model usable in Excel/Power BI

aboutBody: CRE-native data experts, seasoned real estate professionals first, technologists second. Independent and provider-agnostic. Built to innovate with speed, autonomy, and precision.
contactBody: Tell us what decision you are trying to enable (lease, exit, growth, budget cycle), what systems are in scope, and your timeline. We will respond with a short plan.
